FAIR: Your new Cedar Bank card comes with one clear offer: a fixed 16.9 percent APR that never changes, no annual fee, no late fee on your first missed payment, and a complete schedule of every charge on page one. We tell you the total cost of every purchase before you swipe. If your circumstances change, call us and we will adjust your plan together, with no penalty and no fine print.
PREDATORY: FINAL NOTICE. Your exclusive five thousand dollar credit line expires at midnight tonight. Act now, because this offer will not be repeated. No credit check, no questions asked, everyone is approved. Operators are standing by. Do not miss this once in a lifetime opportunity. Fees apply. Call in the next fifteen minutes to lock in your rate before it is gone forever.
TEASER: Enjoy zero percent introductory APR for the first six months on your new Advantage card. After the introductory period ends, a variable APR of 29.99 percent applies to your balance. Balance transfers carry a five percent transfer fee, and missing a single payment ends the introductory rate immediately. Interest on remaining balances is then calculated from the original purchase date.
TRUST_SIGNAL: The Pathway card is designed to build your credit. We report every on-time payment to all three credit bureaus, and your responsible use is rewarded: after six consecutive on-time payments, your credit line doubles automatically. You can track your credit score for free in the app every month, and our coaches review your progress with you twice a year.
THREAT: Our records show your account is sixty days past due. If payment of the full balance is not received within ten days, your account will be referred to a collections agency, additional fees will be added to your balance, and this delinquency will be reported to the national credit bureaus, which may affect your ability to obtain credit, housing, or employment in the future.
CONTROL: The community garden opens for the season on the first Saturday of April. Volunteers meet at the main gate at nine in the morning to prepare the beds, turn the compost, and plant the early greens. Tools and gloves are provided, and new members are always welcome. A shared lunch follows at noon under the old oak tree beside the tool shed.
